announcements.title: NOW OPEN 7 DAYS PER WEEK
announcements.intro: Starting this week we'll be open on Sunday & Monday again. Beginning this week, including Sunday/Monday of Oct 12 and Oct 13, we're going back to how we started in 2022 — open 7 days per week. Feel free to place orders any day, including Sunday/Monday. Thanks everyone!

announcements.title: Group Chat Reminder
announcements.intro: Please DM us for the link to our community chat if you're not already in it. We post promotional codes for free items with orders, sneak peeks, and general info about upcoming drops. It's a good place to connect with other members of the community — producers and growers of several products we carry are in there too, making it a great place to ask questions. We post pics there right when they're taken before they hit the gallery, plus important announcements and updates.
